core-tatqa-train-v1.scope: Frozen complementary snapshot plus original Train financial-document annotations; no organizational efficacy claim

freshDataRestore.scope: Fresh-directory restore from the public data archive, followed by actual source and immutable-parent audits; no model evaluation
